prompt: Build our weather assistant with LangChain (installed with uv; run things with `uv run`). In app/agent.py: define a tool `get_weather(city: str) -> str` that returns f"It is sunny in {city}"; export `build_agent(model)` that takes any LangChain chat model and returns an agent that can call that tool, with the system prompt "You are a helpful weather assistant."; and export `ask(agent, question: str) -> str` that runs the agent on one user question and returns the text of its final answer.
